name: La Quinta Resort & Club
positioning: Desert resort of Spanish-style casitas, suites and villas on 45 acres of gardens beneath the Santa Rosa Mountains, with golf, tennis, many pools and a spa
best_for: Golfers and tennis players who want courses and courts on site
Couples who want a casita with a private patio and hot tub
Families who want a family-friendly main pool

facts.text: La Quinta Resort & Club is set beneath the Santa Rosa Mountains.
The casitas, suites and villas sit amid gardens on 45 acres of grounds.
The Main Pool is family-friendly and has views of the Santa Rosa Mountains.
Casita pools are located just outside guest rooms.
Guests can play golf at the resort's five championship courses.
The resort offers 8 pickleball courts for resort guests and members.
Spa La Quinta offers water therapies with Vichy showers.
Spa La Quinta has a Sage Room and a Tranquility Garden.
Fitness classes are free of charge for resort guests.
Starlight Casitas have private balconies for stargazing.
Morgan's in the Desert serves contemporary American cuisine inspired by the Coachella Valley.
The resort's Mexican restaurant has a traditional Oaxacan motif, a double-sided fireplace and more than 100 tequilas.

highlights.text: The resort's Spanish-style casitas have private patios and hot tubs.
PLUNGE at the Renker Pool is a pool reserved for adults.
The resort has a sunken tournament-style center court for tennis, with USPTA-certified instructors.
A History Walk on the 45-acre grounds stops at landmarks including the original Renker pool and the Frank Capra casita.
Spa La Quinta's Garden Bath Ritual is a soak in a private garden tub surrounded by the Santa Rosa Mountains and palm trees.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes that a resort fee applies for amenities and services.
Guests under 16 are not permitted in the fitness center or in fitness classes.
